title: MAP Sensor Low Voltage
shortDescription: MAP sensor signal below operational threshold.
fullDescription: MerCruiser PCM detects MAP sensor circuit voltage below 0.2V. ECU enters limp mode.

title: ECT Sensor Low Input
fullDescription: MerCruiser detects ECT signal shorted low. Default fuel map applied.

faq.a: Long-term rich running fouls cat and plugs.

title: TPS A Low Voltage
shortDescription: Throttle position sensor signal below range.
fullDescription: DTS or cable-throttle MerCruiser PCM reads TPS below 0.2V. Engine may stay at idle.

fixSteps.title: Replace TPS
fixSteps.instruction: Install new TPS or throttle body.

faq.a: May be locked at idle; tow advised.

title: O2 Sensor Lean
fullDescription: MerCruiser O2 sensor stays lean. Could be exhaust leak, vacuum leak, or sensor.

fixSteps.title: Inspect manifold
fixSteps.instruction: Check for exhaust leaks before O2 sensor.

faq.a: Yes, marine exhaust manifolds corrode and leak before failure.

title: Injector 1 Circuit
fullDescription: PCM cannot drive injector 1. Misfire on that cylinder.
whenToCallPro: If fuel rail removal is required.

faq.a: Electrical faults need replacement, not cleaning.

title: Random Multi-Cylinder Misfire
shortDescription: PCM detects misfires across multiple cylinders.
fullDescription: MerCruiser PCM logs P0300 when misfire counters exceed limit. Often spark or fuel related.

fixSteps.title: Fuel system check
fixSteps.instruction: Replace fuel filter, drain old fuel if needed.

fixSteps.title: Cap and rotor
fixSteps.instruction: On distributor systems, replace cap and rotor.

whenToCallPro: If compression test reveals mechanical issues.

faq.a: Use marine-rated plugs to avoid corrosion issues.

title: Crankshaft Position Sensor
fullDescription: MerCruiser PCM does not see crank reference. Engine cranks but no start.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Locate CKP near harmonic balancer; check for damage.

fixSteps.title: Test sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Verify resistance and AC output during cranking.

faq.a: Yes, CKPs are a typical no-start cause on MPI engines.

title: Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold
shortDescription: Cat efficiency low on cat-equipped engines.
fullDescription: On catalyst-equipped MerCruisers, the rear O2 mirrors front, indicating poor cat efficiency.

fixSteps.title: Verify O2 readings
fixSteps.instruction: Compare front and rear O2 traces with scan tool.

faq.a: Removing cats violates EPA marine emissions rules.

title: Sea Pump Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Sea-water pump pressure or flow sensor signal invalid.
fullDescription: MerCruiser engines with sea-pump pressure monitoring report sensor fault. Could indicate flow loss.

fixSteps.title: Clean strainer
fixSteps.instruction: Open raw water strainer and clean debris.

title: Oil Pressure Sensor Low
shortDescription: Oil pressure sensor signal below threshold.
fullDescription: MerCruiser PCM reports oil pressure signal too low. Could be sensor or actual low pressure.

fixSteps.title: Verify with mechanical gauge
fixSteps.instruction: Install mechanical gauge to read actual oil pressure.

fixSteps.title: Replace sender
fixSteps.instruction: If actual pressure is normal, replace electronic sender.

whenToCallPro: If actual pressure is low, internal engine work needed.

faq.a: Only after confirming actual oil pressure is normal.
